Name: JP's Starter Pack - Quick Progress Kit
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Starter Packs[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because starting a new game from scratch can be very annoying, you just need to speed things up a little! Just a little bit, we didn't come here to cheat, RIGHT?[/i][/b][/size][/color]



[size=4][b][i]Starter Pack allows you to choose from a variety of items grouped into several categories that will help you get started faster without feeling like you're cheating or anything like that.[/i]
[/b]

[i][color=#00ff00]Now the gift that normally contains 15 parsnip seeds will give you all the items you need to start your adventure![/color][/i]
I highly recommend installing the “[color=#ff7700][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/color]” mod so you can customize Starter Pack to your liking and read the descriptions for each section. [b][i]You can find everything under the mod: "[color=#00ffff](JP98) Starter Pack[/color]".
[/i][/b][/size]
[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]By default, all packages except Farming are disabled. Remember to configure everything before starting your new game.[/size][/color][/b]


[size=4]All packages have at least 4 options (Starter, Explorer, Advanced, and Special), each containing more and better items depending on your need to advance faster.[b] [color=#ff0000]If you don't want to use a package, you can simply disable it![/color][/b]
[/size][size=4][b][i][color=#00ffff]As an example, we have the Crafting package:[/color][/i][/b] 
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Starter contains 175 wood and 75 stone, which is half the resources needed to build a Barn. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Explorer contains 350 wood and 150 stone to build a Barn. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Advanced has 500 wood, 200 stone, and 5 clay to build a Barn and have enough left over to build a Coop.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Special has x750 wood, x350 stone, x10 clay, and x5 copper bars to build a Barn, a Coop, and a Silo.[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia]
[/font][/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
You decide which package to use and how to use it. You don't necessarily have to use it to construct buildings; the choice lies deep within your heart (and perhaps in a part of your left lung).
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#00ffff]You can also modify the amount of gold that the gift can give you, from not activating this package to 10,000g.[/color]


[/size][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's it. Using GMCM, you'll find descriptions of each package so you can see what they contain and make your choices. Have fun bringing the game back to life once again. What a great game, my goodness.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission[/b][/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
